verdict.rationale: The evidence says only that Sai and its open-source framework control computers like a human, looking at the screen and clicking, typing and scrolling with keyboard and mouse. Nothing documents how those inputs actually reach the device: there is no mention of USB HID, accessibility APIs, synthetic OS input events, or the injection mechanism on cloud VMs or BYOD Mac/Windows machines. Describing the interaction style is adjacent to this story and does not document the control path.
